summary: Tucker County, WV: the state's 1922 Backbone Mountain tower was replaced in 1963 by the Olson Tower, which stands on about the same site.

facts.status_note: Removed. Its 1963 replacement, the Olson Tower, stands on about the same site on the mountaintop.

access.note: Olson Tower: open when roads are snow-free; the cab is closed, but visitors may climb to just below it.

visit.trail_note: Forest Service directions end at a parking lot below the Olson Tower on Forest Road 717.

notes_for_editor: Dates: the Forest Service and two Wikipedia pages give 1922 for the state's tower; the tourism guide gives about 1916 for the first tower and 1922 elsewhere, so the 1916 figure is left as a disagreement. Access: the Forest Service and the tourism guide differ on season, and Wikipedia differs from the Forest Service on the walkway; all three are reported. Names: Wikipedia's Olson page says 'Ernst B. Olson' and the Backbone Mountain page says 'Ernest B. Olson'; the story does not name him. Photo credit: the register page header credits the 1935 photo to the National Archives while the photo caption credits the U.S. Forest Service; the record uses the Forest Service credit and was not changed. Location: an OpenStreetMap node named 'Olson Lookout Tower' (node 356527482, 39.1068, -79.6034, in the cached overpass extract) sits roughly 150 m east of the record point at 39.10668, -79.601629 by my calculation. That node is the Olson structure, not the removed tower, so the record point may be better placed on the Olson Tower; the editor should decide. The original 1922 tower's remains are not described in any source read.
